correctness.rationale: A labeled word determines exactly one indexed closed walk by taking its length-five window at each residue. Conversely, overlapping successive windows on a closed walk forces every window coordinate to be the corresponding leading letter at a shifted index, even when n<5; thus the six-letter tests cover every cyclic forbidden square, including across more than one boundary. Hence c_n=tr(A^n), without any extra rotation factor. Independently ran python3 /workspace/cyclic_short_square_check.py (Python with SymPy): generated all admissible six-letter blocks and their five-letter overlaps, checked the complete state set (30 states, 42 edges), computed and factored the exact characteristic polynomial, reproduced every coefficient of the proposed det(I−zA) and the first twenty traces, directly counted n=1..9 by modular indexing, and tested the four stated loops at the common state 01210. The formal trace-log identity establishes the rational zeta expression for all n. The traces exclude exactly the six listed small candidates once the loop argument is applied: lengths 4 and 6 generate all even n≥4 and bases 11 and 13 plus the same semigroup give all odd n≥11. A rotation by j fixes exactly the repeats from a labeled word of length gcd(n,j), which proves Burnside's formula. Divisor inversion on least periods counts the primitive words, each giving one orbit per n distinct rotations. The source checker was inspected, not run. The stated positive spectrum concerns allowable circumferences, not an asserted spectrum of least periods.
residual_risks: Only a ternary distinguished alphabet and root lengths 1,2,3 are covered; short n use the periodic-extension convention, not finite-once circular testing. The finite trace and count checks are not used as extrapolation.

value.rationale: The forbidden lengths are motivated independently by short tandem-duplication irreducibility. Exact periodic counts are needed for rotation and least-period orbit counts, which cannot be recovered from a linear growth rate. The evaluated determinant, coefficients and explicit all-length witnesses provide reusable exact information beyond the generic transfer-matrix recipe or the known existence of many fully square-free circles; the gap pattern does not merely track the full circular square-free exceptions.
residual_risks: No claim of a general alphabet theorem or downstream coding improvement; the applications claimed are exact periodic and orbit enumerations for this one natural constraint.
